{{Top|leg}}
'''Tetranni body-sculptors''' were a group renowned for their ability to change their shape via complicated and enthralling dances. The [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Faarl]] the Conqueror kept a group of Tetranni body-sculptors for his entertainment in his [[Fortress Baarlos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pochi]].<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tetranni body-sculptors are mentioned in passing in the [[West End Games]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], published in [[1993]]. The book reveals very little about the group, leaving ambiguous whether they are an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-using tradition, or something else entirely.
